overall: At 3:09 AM ET on June 21, Atlanta is in the overnight cool-down phase with the current temp at 71.6°F and a running max of only 73.4°F — well below where the day will peak. No active alerts and a mostly sunny Sunday forecast means the heat cap will largely depend on cloud/storm timing in the late afternoon.
